title: Original task help through existing private correspondence

operator.credentialLocator: The samedaydesk.com Node process env CORRESPONDENCE_ADMIN_TOKEN. It is not in this repository.

notes: Discover the existing visitor entry, persist one local attempt, register, and post one request event with the writer grant.
Read the private reply with the reader grant. Pending qualification is the default. A reply is not acceptance or reuse.
Example consent is a separate correction and defaults off. Inability to run a timer is not required.
The operator lists task-bearing projects with the existing admin credential. This file does not call the network.
